markets.rules_primary: If the FDA approves intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) with pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA) for adjuvant treatment of completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma for marketing before Apr 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An approval is defined as:

For new drugs: FDA issuance of an approval letter for a New Drug Application (NDA) or Biologics License Application (BLA)
For already-marketed drugs seeking new indications: FDA approval of a supplemental NDA (sNDA) or supplemental BLA (sBLA) for the specific indication referenced
For generic drugs: FDA approval of an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA)
For biosimilars: FDA approval of a 351(k) application

The following constitute approvals that trigger the Payout Criterion:

Standard approval (traditional approval based on clinical benefit)
Accelerated approval (based on surrogate endpoints)
Approval with Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS)
Approval with restricted distribution or indication limitations, except compassionate use/expanded access programs

The following do NOT constitute approvals:

Complete Response Letters (CRLs) indicating the application cannot be approved in its current form
Approvable letters that require additional actions before approval
Tentative approvals pending patent or exclusivity expiration
FDA requests for additional information or studies
Extension of Prescription Drug User Fee Amendments dates
Approval for compassionate use or expanded access programs only
Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) without full approval
Approval only for export or for use outside the United States

If the FDA issues a Complete Response Letter before Apr 1, 2027, the market will resolve to No unless the FDA subsequently approves intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) with pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA) for adjuvant treatment of completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma after addressing the CRL concerns and before Apr 1, 2027.

If the FDA convenes an Advisory Committee that votes against approval but the FDA approves intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) with pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA) for adjuvant treatment of completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma anyway before Apr 1, 2027, the market will resolve to Yes.

If intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) with pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA) for adjuvant treatment of completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma receives accelerated approval that is later withdrawn before Apr 1, 2027, the market will resolve based on whether the initial accelerated approval occurred after Issuance (Yes), regardless of the subsequent withdrawal.

If the drug sponsor withdraws the application before FDA action and before Apr 1, 2027, the market will resolve to No immediately.

An approval is defined as:

For new drugs: FDA issuance of an approval letter for a New Drug Application (NDA) or Biologics License Application (BLA)
For already-marketed drugs seeking new indications: FDA approval of a supplemental NDA (sNDA) or supplemental BLA (sBLA) for the specific indication referenced
For generic drugs: FDA approval of an Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA)
For biosimilars: FDA approval of a 351(k) application

The following constitute approvals that trigger the Payout Criterion:

Standard approval (traditional approval based on clinical benefit)
Accelerated approval (based on surrogate endpoints)
Approval with Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS)
Approval with restricted distribution or indication limitations, except compassionate use/expanded access programs

The following do NOT constitute approvals:

Complete Response Letters (CRLs) indicating the application cannot be approved in its current form
Approvable letters that require additional actions before approval
Tentative approvals pending patent or exclusivity expiration
FDA requests for additional information or studies
Extension of Prescription Drug User Fee Amendments dates
Approval for compassionate use or expanded access programs only
Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) without full approval
Approval only for export or for use outside the United States

If the FDA issues a Complete Response Letter before Jul 1, 2028, the market will resolve to No unless the FDA subsequently approves intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) with pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA) for adjuvant treatment of completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma after addressing the CRL concerns and before Jul 1, 2028.

If the FDA convenes an Advisory Committee that votes against approval but the FDA approves intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) with pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA) for adjuvant treatment of completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma anyway before Jul 1, 2028, the market will resolve to Yes.

If intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157) with pembrolizumab (KEYTRUDA) for adjuvant treatment of completely resected stage IIB-IV melanoma receives accelerated approval that is later withdrawn before Jul 1, 2028, the market will resolve based on whether the initial accelerated approval occurred after Issuance (Yes), regardless of the subsequent withdrawal.

If the drug sponsor withdraws the application before FDA action and before Jul 1, 2028, the market will resolve to No immediately.

markets.rules_secondary:
This must be confirmed, verified, or established as factual by at least one Source Agency.

News confirmation is defined as a published article, broadcast segment, or official news report by a Source Agency that A) explicitly states the U.S. Department of Justice filed the qualifying civil antitrust complaint, B) is based on journalistic investigation, sources, or evidence, and C) is presented as factual reporting rather than speculation, rumor, or unverified allegation.

An HSR Second Request, investigative demand, subpoena, investigation announcement, or settlement without a qualifying complaint does NOT qualify.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if a snap election is officially announced.
markets.rules_primary: If Canada officially announces a snap election for its national legislature or head of government before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A "snap election" is a national election for the legislature or head of government called to occur at least 90 days earlier than either the previously scheduled election date or the latest constitutionally or legally required date. The announcement must be made by a person or body with the legal authority to call such elections, must specify an actual election date, and must occur after Issuance, regardless of when the election is scheduled to take place.

This market concerns a general election to the House of Commons. By-elections to fill individual vacancies do not qualify.

markets.rules_primary: If Alabama (IPEDS Unit ID: 100751) has the lowest admissions rate among all schools that compete in the SEC for football in the 2026 season for the fall term of 2026, the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Important Information:
The admissions rate of an institution is its total number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate students admitted divided by its total number of first-time, degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate applicants for the fall term of 2026.
The admissions rate is determined from the first public release by the National Center for Education Statistics of Admissions component data for the fall term of 2026 that is designated as provisional (or, if the Source Agency no longer uses that designation, the first public release not designated as preliminary or early release data). 
If multiple qualifying institutions are tied for the lowest admissions rate, “Yes” positions will pay $1/N (rounded down to the nearest cent), where N is the number of tied institutions, and “No” positions will pay 1 minus the "Yes" payout.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if all seats have been called and additional recounts/by-elections will not affect the market outcome.
markets.rules_primary: If Morena has won at least 200 seats in the 2027 Mexican Chamber of Deputies election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A seat is considered "won" when a candidate affiliated with the specified party has been declared elected by the relevant electoral authority and either:
The time for legal challenges has expired
Challenges have been resolved
The member has taken their seat

Party affiliation is determined by the party under whose banner the candidate was elected, regardless of subsequent changes. The count is determined when the new legislature takes their seats, even if some seats remain vacant or challenged. If the election is postponed beyond one year from the original date or cancelled entirely, the market resolves to the last fair market price. Only seats actually contested and filled are counted in partial elections. By-elections after the main election are included only if seated simultaneously with the rest of the legislature.

Seats refers to seats in the Chamber of Deputies, both the 300 won by plurality in single-member districts and the 200 assigned by proportional representation. Seats in the Senate do not count toward any market in this event.

Morena may stand with other parties on a registered coalition in some districts. Seats won by such a coalition are attributed as follows:

A seat won by a coalition candidate counts toward the Morena market only where the National Electoral Institute's official assignment of seats by party, made under the registered coalition agreement, credits that seat to Morena.
INE's separate recount of coalition seats by deputies' actual party membership, used only to check overrepresentation limits, does not count.
markets.title: Will Morena win at least 200 seats in the 2027 Mexican Chamber of Deputies election?

markets.rules_primary: If the number of candidates who participate in the first RNC-sanctioned 2028 Republican presidential primary debate is at least 2 before Mar 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An RNC-sanctioned debate is a debate officially sanctioned by the Republican National Committee (RNC) as a 2028 Republican presidential primary debate. The first one is the earliest such debate in which at least two candidates for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination participate together.

A debate held over more than one night, or in more than one stage on the same day (such as a main debate and an earlier undercard), is one debate. Every candidate who participates in any night or stage is counted once. Later debates do NOT change the number.

The following do NOT count:

Announcing or scheduling a debate that has not taken place
Forums, town halls or other events where candidates appear one at a time
Debates not sanctioned by the RNC

If no such debate takes place before Mar 1, 2028, the number is 0.
